drug_class: Low Molecular Weight Heparin (Blood Thinner / Anticoagulant)
purpose: Enoxaparin is a blood thinner used to prevent or treat dangerous blood clots in your legs, lungs, or other parts of your body. It is commonly used after surgery, during hospital stays, or for conditions like deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE). It may also be used to help prevent clots in people with certain heart conditions.
how_it_works: Enoxaparin works by blocking certain proteins in your blood that help clots form, making it harder for your blood to clot too easily. Think of it like putting a gentle brake on your blood's clotting system so dangerous clots cannot build up. It does not dissolve clots that are already there, but it stops them from getting bigger and prevents new ones from forming.
common_side_effects: The most common side effect is bruising, bleeding, or irritation at the injection site where you give yourself the shot. You may also notice minor bleeding such as bleeding gums or nosebleeds. Some people experience mild pain, redness, or a small lump under the skin at the injection spot.
warnings: Because this medication thins your blood, it can cause serious or even life-threatening bleeding — call your doctor right away if you notice unusual bruising, blood in your urine or stool, coughing up blood, or bleeding that will not stop. Tell all your doctors and dentist that you take this medication before any procedure or surgery. Do not take ibuprofen, aspirin, or other blood thinners without asking your doctor first. If you have kidney problems, your dose may need to be adjusted. Do not stop taking it without talking to your doctor.
typical_dosing: Enoxaparin is given as an injection under the skin (subcutaneous), usually in the belly area. The dose depends on what it is being used for, your weight, and your kidney function. A typical preventive dose might be 40 mg once a day, while a treatment dose for a blood clot might be 1 mg per kilogram of body weight twice a day. Your doctor or nurse will show you exactly how to inject it at home if needed.
